questions.prompt: A mushroom is a kind of plant.
questions.explain: Fungi are a separate kingdom; they cannot make food from sunlight.

questions.prompt: Which mushroom causes the most deaths from mushroom poisoning?
questions.explain: Its toxins destroy the liver, and cooking does not remove them.

questions.prompt: Cooking a death cap makes it safe to eat.
questions.explain: Its amatoxins are not destroyed by heat.

questions.prompt: Which red mushroom with white spots appears in fairy tales and "Super Mario"?
questions.explain: It is poisonous despite its friendly look.

questions.prompt: What do mushrooms release to make new fungi?
questions.explain: Spores are tiny and spread by wind, water and animals.

questions.prompt: Portobello, chestnut and white button mushrooms are all…
questions.explain: They are ages and strains of Agaricus bisporus.

questions.prompt: Which antibiotic was first discovered in a mould, a kind of fungus?
Which fungus helps bread dough rise?
questions.explain: Yeast gives off carbon dioxide bubbles.

questions.prompt: One of the largest living things on Earth is a honey fungus in which US state?
questions.explain: It spreads underground across nearly 10 square kilometres.

questions.prompt: Some mushrooms glow in the dark.
questions.explain: Ghost fungus and jack-o'-lantern mushrooms are bioluminescent.
